description.en_US: Stock ActiveWindow indexes the monitors array by Hyprland monitor ID, which breaks whenever IDs stop matching array positions (e.g. after switching from the internal panel to an external monitor) — the bar then shows 'Workspace N' instead of the focused window's title. This module overrides the binding with an id-based lookup via an inserted Binding{}. Self-retiring once upstream fixes the line.
description.zh_TW: stock 的 ActiveWindow 拿 Hyprland monitor ID 當陣列索引，ID 與陣列位置不一致時（例如從內建螢幕換到外接螢幕）標題區只會顯示「Workspace N」。本模塊插入 Binding{} 以 id 查找覆蓋錯誤綁定；上游修復後錨點消失、模塊自動退場。

description.en_US: Visually tunes the shell's central animation tokens with validated cubic Bezier curves, duration, velocity, reduced motion, and real QML previews for Bezier, delay, and spring parameters.
description.zh_TW: 以視覺化方式調校 shell 中央動畫 token：經驗證的 cubic Bezier 曲線、時長、速度、減少動態效果，以及 Bezier、延遲與彈簧參數的真實 QML 預覽。
description.zh_CN: 以可视化方式调校 shell 中央动画 token：经验证的 cubic Bezier 曲线、时长、速度、减少动态效果，以及 Bezier、延迟与弹簧参数的真实 QML 预览。

description.en_US: Long-term battery history and analytics integrated into the stock battery indicator. Its stock popup is replaced by Battery Trend's informational superset, and clicking the stock ring opens the detail panel. The sidebar tile is offered by edit mode; an optional bar sparkline remains off by default.
description.zh_TW: 整合進 stock 電池指示器的長期電量趨勢與分析。原生彈窗會被本模塊的資訊超集取代，點擊 stock 電量環直接開啟詳情面板；側欄磁貼可在編輯模式加入，可選 bar 趨勢線預設關閉。
description.zh_CN: 集成进 stock 电池指示器的长期电量趋势与分析。原生弹窗会被本模块的信息超集替代，点击 stock 电量环直接打开详情面板；侧栏磁贴可在编辑模式添加，可选 bar 趋势线默认关闭。

name.zh_TW: Bar 時鐘客製化（實驗性）
name.zh_CN: Bar 时钟自定义（实验性）

description.en_US: Experimental Tier B bar clock customization; may be deprecated if the stock center layout changes or a safer replacement ships.
description.zh_TW: 實驗性的 Tier B bar 時鐘客製化；若 stock 中央版面改動或有更安全的替代方案，可能棄用。
description.zh_CN: 实验性的 Tier B bar 时钟自定义；若 stock 中央布局改动或有更安全的替代方案，可能弃用。

description.en_US: Purpose-built Material panels for the stock Wi-Fi and Bluetooth indicators. The panels render nm-applet and Blueman D-Bus menus without taking ownership of network or Bluetooth state. Duplicate tray icons are hidden; stock status icons and left-click behavior remain unchanged.
description.zh_TW: 為 stock Wi-Fi 與藍牙指示圖示提供 Material 面板，直接呈現 nm-applet 與 Blueman 的 D-Bus 選單，不接管網路或藍牙狀態。重複托盤圖示會隱藏；stock 狀態圖示與左鍵行為維持不變。
description.zh_CN: 为 stock Wi-Fi 与蓝牙指示图标提供 Material 面板，直接呈现 nm-applet 与 Blueman 的 D-Bus 菜单，不接管网络或蓝牙状态。重复托盘图标会隐藏；stock 状态图标与左键行为保持不变。

description.en_US: Visual RAM/swap viewer and cleaner: pressure-coloured bar percentage widget (hideable to save bar space), hover popup with an honest composition mini-bar (in use / reclaimable cache / free always sum to MemTotal), and a panel with an animated composition bar, treemap-style top-process blocks (area = RSS, double-click your own to SIGTERM), swap compaction (swapoff+swapon) and cache dropping (drop_caches) behind a polkit/sudo auth prompt with a measured freed delta. Optional sidebar quick-toggle tile (Tier B patch) opens the panel.
description.zh_TW: 視覺化 RAM/swap 檢視與清理工具：壓力變色百分比 bar 元件（可隱藏以節省 bar 空間）、hover 彈窗含誠實的組成迷你條（應用程式／可回收快取／可用，總和恆等於 MemTotal）、詳細面板——動畫組成條、treemap 式程序方塊（面積＝RSS，點兩下可結束自己的程序）、整理 swap 與清除快取（polkit/sudo 認證後執行並回報實測釋放量）。可選側欄快速開關磁貼（Tier B 補丁），點擊開啟面板。
description.zh_CN: 可视化 RAM/swap 查看与清理工具：压力变色百分比 bar 组件（可隐藏以节省 bar 空间）、悬停弹窗含诚实的组成迷你条（应用程序／可回收缓存／可用，总和恒等于 MemTotal）、详细面板——动画组成条、treemap 式进程方块（面积＝RSS，双击可结束自己的进程）、整理 swap 与清除缓存（polkit/sudo 认证后执行并回报实测释放量）。可选侧栏快速开关磁贴（Tier B 补丁），点击打开面板。

system.hint: procps-ng — top-process sampling in the panel
polkit — auth prompt for the swap/cache cleanup actions

description.en_US: Up/down bandwidth meter for the bar: live rates, DNS ping, boot/today/month totals (whole-system and per-app), Bezier trend graphs with dynamic scale, and a per-app usage ranking (best-effort pktz eBPF payload estimate with nethogs fallback) in the hover popup. Reads /proc/net/dev; common tunnel and container interfaces are excluded by default to reduce VPN double-counting.
description.zh_TW: Bar 上下行流量計：即時速率、DNS ping、開機/本日/本月累計（全系統與 per-app）、動態刻度貝茲趨勢曲線、hover 彈窗含 per-app 佔用排行（優先使用 pktz eBPF payload 盡力估算，降級 nethogs）。預設排除常見隧道/容器介面，以減少 VPN 重複計算。窄螢幕自動改用雙行緊湊版面。

system.hint: sudo pacman -S nethogs  # per-app usage in the popup; for rootless capture: sudo setcap 'cap_net_admin,cap_net_raw,cap_dac_read_search,cap_sys_ptrace+ep' /usr/bin/nethogs

description.en_US: Phone-style screen time tracking with Daily and Trends tabs. Focus accounting via Quickshell's native ToplevelManager (event-driven, pauses while locked, suspend gaps not counted) keeps a browsable 30-day history. Daily shows a selected day's total, app ranking, AI work summary, and today's hourly histogram. Trends shows recorded-complete-day averages with coverage and previous-period comparison, honest missing-day charts, and a Monday-to-Sunday hourly heatmap accumulated from v1.3 onward. A separate AI work-time dimension samples agent process trees even while unfocused or locked. Bar pill, IPC detail panel, and optional Tier B sidebar tile included.
description.zh_TW: 手機風格的螢幕使用時間統計，詳情分成「每日／趨勢」。以 Quickshell 原生 ToplevelManager 做焦點記帳（事件驅動、鎖屏暫停、休眠時段不入帳），保留可瀏覽的 30 天歷史。「每日」顯示選定日期總時長、應用排行、AI 工作摘要與今日時段圖；「趨勢」顯示有紀錄完整日平均、覆蓋率、前期比較、誠實標示缺日的圖表，以及從 1.3 起累積的週一至週日時段熱力圖。另有獨立 AI 工作時長維度，即使未聚焦或鎖屏仍會取樣 agent 程序樹。含 Bar 藥丸、IPC 詳情面板與可選 Tier B 側欄磁貼。
